description_en: Resets the hit count of an access control policy in a specified VPC firewall policy group to zero
description_zh: 将指定的VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略的命中计数清零
name: ResetVpcFirewallRuleHitCount

parameters.description_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To reset the hit count of an access control policy, specify the unique ID of the policy. You can call the [DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy](~~159758~~) operation to obtain the ID.
